SELECT seq_project_team_no.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO project_team (no, writer_no, writer, title, description, requirements, max_member, current_member, status, apply_deadline, team_deadline, reg_date) VALUES (#{no}, #{writerNo}, #{writer}, #{title}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{maxMember}, 1, #{status}, TO_DATE(#{applyDeadline}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{teamDeadline}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), sysdate)
mapper.select: SELECT no, writer_no, writer, title, description, requirements, max_member, current_member, status, TO_CHAR(apply_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_deadline, TO_CHAR(team_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS team_deadline, TO_CHAR(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date FROM project_team WHERE writer_no = #{writerNo} ORDER BY no DESC

SELECT a.no, a.team_no, t.title AS team_title, a.applicant_no, a.applicant_id, a.apply_content, a.apply_status, TO_CHAR(a.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date FROM project_team_apply a JOIN project_team t ON a.team_no = t.no WHERE a.applicant_no = #{applicantNo} ORDER BY a.no DESC

SELECT no, writer_no, writer, title, description, requirements, max_member, current_member, status, TO_CHAR(apply_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_deadline, TO_CHAR(team_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS team_deadline, TO_CHAR(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date FROM project_team ORDER BY no DESC
